title: 2023 Panini Prizm #340 Dylan Horton Houston Texans Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Prizm sports trading card features rookie Dylan Horton from the Houston Texans. With a card number of 340, this card is a must-have for any football fan or sports trading card collector. The card is part of the base set and has a Prizm parallel/variety, making it a unique and valuable addition to any collection.

The card is manufactured by Panini and is an official National Football League (NFL) product. It is a great way to show support for your favorite team and player. Whether you are a collector or a fan, this card is a great addition to any sports trading card collection.
